generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Generate diffs, manifests, hashes, compile and test results, provenance, and acceptance evidence for the build.

contract.purpose_user_function: Generate traceable build evidence including diffs, hashes, manifests, command/test results, provenance, and acceptance status.
contract.valid_inputs: Build outputs, repository diff, artifact paths, commands/logs, tests/compile results, task/sprint/node IDs, and acceptance obligations.
contract.expected_outputs: Evidence pack/ledger entries, manifests/hashes, result/handoff artifacts, and acceptance verdict references.
contract.state_side_effects: Writes manifests, evidence/ledger, reports, handoffs, and result sidecars.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Missing artifact, hash mismatch, uncorrelated result, failed mandatory check, unsupported pass claim, or write failure prevents accepted evidence.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Evidence ledger and benchmark manifests are shipped; exact build pack composition varies by capsule/workflow.
contract.success_evidence: Every claimed output has stable path/hash/provenance and mandatory checks; tampering or missing artifacts invalidate pass.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: diff; manifest/hash; command result; tests; provenance; missing/tampered artifact; acceptance link.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md §Basic Workflow and Appendix AutoSci Commands; docs/WORKFLOW_DESIGN.md Phases 2-5; AGENTS.md Scope and Local Workflow
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: Builder work is dispatched through harness/lib/operator_runtime.py and physical operators; task-specific interfaces include .agents/skills/exp-run/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-draft/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-compile/SKILL.md, skills/test/SKILL.md
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Solar ships primarily as a Claude Code overlay. Concrete builds depend on selected physical operators, language toolchains, credentials, datasets, hardware, and approval/write-scope policy.

implementation.interfaces: Builder work is dispatched through harness/lib/operator_runtime.py and physical operators; task-specific interfaces include .agents/skills/exp-run/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-draft/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-compile/SKILL.md, skills/test/SKILL.md
